description: This file manages Synology Chat gateway runtime, including startup issue collection, route registration, and webhook handling.

classes.name: SynologyGatewayLog
classes.description: Defines logging functions for info, warn, and error messages.

classes.name: SynologyGatewayStartupIssueCode
classes.description: Enumerates possible startup issue codes for Synology Gateway.

classes.name: SynologyGatewayStartupIssue
classes.description: Represents a startup issue with code, log level, and message.

methods.name: buildStartupIssue
methods.description: Constructs a startup issue object with specified code, message, and log level.

methods.name: logStartupIssues
methods.description: Logs a list of startup issues using provided log.

methods.name: getRouteKey
methods.description: Generates a unique route key based on accountId and webhookPath.

methods.name: createUnknownArgsLogAdapter
methods.description: Creates a log adapter that forwards logs to the provided SynologyGatewayLog.

methods.name: collectSynologyGatewayStartupIssues
methods.description: Collects startup issues for a given Synology account configuration.

methods.name: collectSynologyGatewayRoutingWarnings
methods.description: Generates routing warnings based on startup issues.

methods.name: validateSynologyGatewayAccountStartup
methods.description: Validates account startup by checking for issues and logging them.

methods.name: registerSynologyWebhookRoute
methods.description: Registers or re-registers a webhook route for a Synology account, returning an unregister function.
